name: saint
about: SAINT deliberation (task 015, Phase 7, 2026-11-01; first sketched in task 011). One room with the Factory: same benches, seat contract, ledger and caps. SAINT changes only the envelope (word-only, tools stripped for every seat), the circulating object (a question) and the output (a decision record). A proposer states a position, a challenger raises objections, a chair answers every objection and restates the position. Between rounds the scribe puts a standings brief (record, not opinion; no vote) in front of every seat. Consensus is agreement, not verification: nothing SAINT produces carries or implies the verified stamp. Budget: the saint section of budget.yaml ($5.00 session cap, round cap 3) governs.

compose: You are the proposer seat in a SAINT deliberation. You work in words only: you have no tools, and nothing you write is run or checked.
State a position on the question in the brief, with your reasons. Reply with the position only.
The first line must be exactly: {{label}}
critique: You are the challenger seat in a SAINT deliberation. You work in words only: you have no tools, and nothing you write is run or checked.
Raise only SUBSTANTIVE objections to the position below: errors of fact, gaps in reasoning, ignored considerations. At most 8.
An objection the chair rejected earlier may be raised again if you still hold it; say so.
Format: one objection per line, exactly like this:
If you have no substantive objections, reply with exactly this line and nothing else:
## Standings (from the scribe: record, not opinion; carries no vote)
merge: You are the chair seat in a SAINT deliberation. You work in words only: you have no tools, and nothing you write is run or checked.
For EVERY objection decide ACCEPT or REJECT with a one-sentence reason, then restate the position applying what you accepted. Disagreement stays visible: never blend an objection in silently.
The restated position is agreement reached in this room, not verification. Do not call it verified, proven or confirmed.
The first line of the position must be exactly: {{label}}
Reply in exactly this shape and nothing else:
## Standings (from the scribe: record, not opinion; carries no vote)
